derivation: from the base of G4813 (συλάω) and (the reduplicated form of) G71 (ἄγω);
def: to lead away as booty, i.e. (figuratively) seduce

occurrences.text: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.
